title: A Digital Twin to Improve Cyber-Social Impact
abstract: arXiv:2610.28430v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The increasing complexity of Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and their integration with IT infrastructures has significantly expanded the cyber threat landscape. Traditional cybersecurity models, primarily based on the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA triad), fail to capture the broader societal and operational impacts of cyberattacks. This paper proposes a novel framework that integrates Digital Twin technology with a Cyber-Social Security model to simulate, analyze, and quantify cyber threats in critical infrastructures. Virtualized ICS environments built with Mininet and MiniCPS are used to model attack scenarios and assess their consequences across technical and social dimensions. translated_title: 一种用于提升网络-社会影响的数字孪生方法
translated_abstract: 工业控制系统（ICS）日益复杂，且与IT基础设施深度融合，这显著扩展了网络威胁的范围。传统网络安全模型主要基于保密性、完整性和可用性（CIA三元组），无法捕捉网络攻击对社会和运营层面造成的更广泛影响。本文提出了一种新颖的框架，将数字孪生技术与网络-社会安全模型相结合，用于对关键基础设施中的网络威胁进行模拟、分析和量化。该框架利用基于Mininet和MiniCPS构建的虚拟化ICS环境来建模攻击场景，并从技术和社会两个维度评估攻击后果。框架的核心是网络-社会脆弱性评分系统，这是一种定量指标，它在CVSS的基础上扩展了一个基于实体和场所两大支柱的社会影响维度，从而产生一个单一的、可复现的安全评分（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出将数字孪生技术与网络-社会安全模型相结合的新框架，通过扩展CVSS构建了包含社会影响维度的CSVSS评分系统，并借助Mininet和MiniCPS虚拟化ICS环境，对关键基础设施中的网络威胁进行模拟、分析与量化评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework integrating Digital Twin technology with a Cyber-Social Security model, introducing the CSVSS scoring system that extends CVSS with a Social Impact dimension, and using Mininet and MiniCPS virtualized ICS environments to simulate, analyze, and quantify cyber threats in critical infrastructures.
